slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must the demand at each demand point be fully satisfied (exactly b_j received), or is it acceptable to receive less than b_j?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each demand point must receive exactly b_j or can receive less, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the fixed cost f_k incurred only when station k is actually used (i.e., when total transshipment through k is positive), and does it add to the variable unit transportation costs in the objective?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the objective composition including fixed and variable costs, and later confirmed the total-cost minimization objective through repeated fixed-cost questions.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 hidden slots but never entered READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; it instead repeated the same unresolved question many times.

summary: The agent recovered the key P0 hidden slots on demand satisfaction and total-cost objective, but then became stuck repeatedly asking about continuous versus integer shipments without reaching a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
